title: 第13章 开战第14章 契约
content_zh:
第13章开战
重生地狱，安德鲁掌心突然浮现一颗灵魂光球，却是伊森的灵魂。
之前，伊森死的时候，在托尼体内的那道魔力化成通道，将伊森的灵魂带入重生地狱。
“超级英雄。”
安德鲁摇了摇头，将伊森的灵魂扔给特拉斯克，重生地狱需要伊森这样的人才。
……
曼哈顿某个大厦，未来的神奇博士里德望着电脑上的股票数据，差点落泪，那么稳健的斯塔克集团股票，为什么会跌成这样？
“这回怕是又要破产了，呃，我为什么要说又？”
里德博士暗暗感叹，就在这时，他的至交好友，一个壮硕光头男，也就是未来的石头人本·格瑞姆跑进来，惊喜的喊道：“里德，托尼·斯塔克被救回来了，正在开新闻发布会。”
“真的？”
里德博士大喜，急忙打开电视，发现托尼正坐在地上开记者发布会。
“太好了，我的股票有救了。”
里德博士激动地喊道，就在这时，电视里的托尼大声宣布：“从现在开始，永久关闭斯塔克集团的武器研发中心。”
“什么？”
里德博士傻眼，他朝本问道：“我没听错吧？斯塔克集团关闭武器研发中心？他们就是卖军火的好不好？”
本怜悯的看着里德博士，说道：“你没听错。”
“完蛋了，斯塔克集团的股价肯定雪崩。”
里德博士哭丧着脸朝本说道：“本，我又破产了。”
“节哀。”
本安慰道，里德博士愕然问道：“为什么你这么淡定？”

“因为你已经破产十多次了。”
本说道：“放心，你不用担心我，在你投资前，我已经提前把未来三个月的工资给领了。”
“……”
里德博士无语，为什么你这么熟练？还有，为什么我这么倒霉？
有人亏钱，自然有人赚钱，安德鲁和托尼的老子霍华德赚的盆满钵满，两人合资开的快抖公司也正式建立，准备正式运行，有霍华德在，快抖公司前途无量。
“现在就等钢铁侠和铁霸王的战斗，希望他们能比电影里更激烈一点。”
安德鲁站在落地窗前，远远眺望斯塔克集团，利用灾难收集灵魂的计划能不能行得通，很快就能知道。
……
“中东战场突然出现一位神秘英雄，他穿着钢铁战甲，四处打击恐怖分子，有人说他是美利坚军方的秘密武器，也有人说他是上帝的使者……”
望着屏幕上的钢铁战衣，斯塔克集团董事，托尼视之为父亲的奥巴代亚·斯坦尼眼里满是贪婪，如果能掌握这种战衣，他将成为美利坚的神！
“托尼，你真会下金蛋。”
光头大胡子奥巴代亚喃喃自语，这时，手机突然响起，他听了几句，兴奋地说道：“我亲自去见你。”
很快，奥巴代亚带着私人保镖团来到中东某个营地，营地的主人，恐怖分子首领拉扎亲自出来迎接他：“朋友，我们终于见面了。”
content_en:
Chapter 13 War begins
Reborn in hell, a ball of soul light suddenly appeared in Andrew's palm, but it was Ethan's soul.
Before, when Ethan died, the magic power in Tony's body turned into a channel, taking Ethan's soul into the hell of rebirth.
"Superhero."
Andrew shook his head and threw Ethan's soul to Trask. Talents like Ethan were needed to reborn in hell.
…
In a building in Manhattan, the future Doctor Reed looked at the stock data on his computer and almost cried. Why did the stock of such a stable Stark Group drop like this?
"I'm afraid I'm going to go bankrupt again this time, uh, why should I say again?"
Dr. Reed secretly sighed. At this moment, his best friend, a sturdy bald man, Ben Grimm, the future stone man, ran in and shouted in surprise: "Reed, Tony Stark has been rescued and is holding a press conference."
"Really?"
Dr. Reed was overjoyed and hurriedly turned on the TV and found Tony sitting on the ground holding a press conference.
"Great, my stock is saved."
Dr. Reed shouted excitedly. At this moment, Tony on the TV loudly announced: "From now on, the Stark Group's weapons research and development center will be permanently closed."
"What?"
Dr. Reed was dumbfounded. He asked Ben: "Did I hear correctly? The Stark Group closed its weapons research and development center? They just sell arms, okay?"
Ben looked at Dr. Reed with pity and said, "You heard me right."
"It's over. Stark Group's stock price will definitely collapse."
Dr. Reed turned to Ben with a sad face and said, "Ben, I'm broke again."
"Condolences."
Ben comforted, and Dr. Reed asked in shock: "Why are you so calm?"
"Because you've been broke a dozen times."
Ben said: "Don't worry, you don't have to worry about me. I have already received your salary for the next three months in advance before you invest."
"..."
Dr. Reed was speechless, why are you so skilled? Also, why am I so unlucky?
Some people lose money, and others naturally make money. Andrew and Tony's father, Howard, make a lot of money. The KuaiDou company jointly opened by the two has been officially established and is ready to be officially launched. With Howard here, KuaiDou company has a bright future.
"Now we are waiting for the battle between Iron Man and Iron Overlord. I hope they will be more intense than in the movie."
Andrew stood in front of the floor-to-ceiling window, looking at the Stark Group from a distance. Whether the plan to use disasters to collect souls would work, he would soon know.
…
"A mysterious hero suddenly appeared on the battlefield in the Middle East. He wore steel armor and fought against terrorists everywhere. Some said he was the secret weapon of the American military, while others said he was the messenger of God..."
Looking at the steel suit on the screen, Obadiah Stane, the director of Stark Group and whom Tony regarded as his father, had greed in his eyes. If he could master this suit, he would become a god in the United States!
"Tony, you really know how to lay golden eggs."
The bald and bearded Obadiah murmured to himself. At this time, his cell phone suddenly rang. He listened to a few words and said excitedly: "I will go see you in person."
Soon, Obadiah brought his personal bodyguard group to a camp in the Middle East. The owner of the camp, the terrorist leader Raza, personally came out to greet him: "Friend, we finally meet."
